abstract: A full-term newborn with karyotype 46, XX was delivered by cesarean section. She had severe respiratory distress and substernal retraction, and underwent emergency operation, but she died on the same day due to respiratory failure. The mother, 26-year-old prima gravida with no history of twinning, had been examined with ultrasonography at the 34th week of her pregnancy, which revealed a fetus with edema of head and neck region, a probable diaphragmatic hernia, polyhydramnios, and a large mediastinal mass with solid and multicystic parts with hypoplasia of the lungs. Autopsy revealed a 9 x 5 x 3 cm lobulated mediastinal mass with both solid and cystic areas, displacing the lungs and the heart postero-inferiorly and thymus anteriorly. The lungs were hypoplasic. Microscopically, the mass showed mature epithelial and mesenchymal tissues with primitive mesenchyme and immature neuroepithelium. All these findings led to the diagnosis of an immature teratoma. Mediastinal teratomas are rare and life-threatening, but early diagnosis and surgical intervention in a newborn with sufficient lung maturation may provide a long survival.
abstract_ja: 46, XXの正期産の新生児が帝王切開で出生した。重度の呼吸窮迫と胸骨上部の陥凹を呈し、緊急手術を受けたが、呼吸不全のためその日のうちに死亡した。母親は26歳の初産婦で、双胎歴はない。妊娠34週の超音波検査で、頭頸部の浮腫、横隔膜ヘルニアの疑い、羊水過多、そして充実性と多嚢胞性の部分を併せ持つ大きな縦隔腫瘤と肺低形成を伴う胎児が認められた。剖検では、9×5×3cmの分葉状で充実性と囊胞性の部分を併せ持つ縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、肺と心臓は後下方へ、胸腺は前方へ圧排されていた。肺は低形成であった。顕微鏡的には、成熟した上皮と間葉組織に加え、原始的な間葉と未熟な神経上皮からなる腫瘤であった。これらの所見から未熟奇形腫と診断された。縦隔奇形腫は稀で生命を脅かすものだが、肺の成熟が十分な新生児における早期診断と外科的介入により、長期生存が得られる可能性がある。
